actions.action: Snip the damaged leaf off at the base if it yellows or the spots spread
Check soil moisture with a finger 3–4 cm deep before watering
Water onto the soil instead of over the leaves when dry
Check that the pot has a drainage hole
Move the plant a little back from the glass to avoid hot midday sun
Alternatively, put up a sheer curtain to filter the window light

reason: The answer correctly sees a single damaged leaf on an otherwise healthy plant but blames weeding, listing sun and water only as alternatives; it mentions trimming only conditionally and includes sun protection, so advice is partial and nothing is harmful.
